name: Prismatic Deluge
body:
School evocation [light]; Level sorcerer/wizard 9

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S

EFFECT

Range medium (100 ft. + 10 ft./level)
Area cylinder (40-ft. radius, 80-ft. high)
Duration instantaneous
Saving Throw see text; Spell Resistance yes

DESCRIPTION

You call down a brilliant, colorful blast of energy in the area. Each creature in the area is affected as though by the prismatic spray spell and are blinded for 2d4 rounds if 8 HD or fewer.
